limitations: Capital scope is explicit: isolated alternatives must never be summed; partitioned markets share exactly $5000 within the same source/allocation/model/scenario group. Rejected market budgets remain unallocated cash.
Only completed sources accepted. Any invalid interval rejects the entire source-symbol; no invented gap fills or cash resets within a reported trial.
Initial holdings are a priced portfolio reclassification, not historical executed purchases. No conversion fee is charged because no conversion is claimed.
Conservative through debits entry-visible intervening depth and queue ahead; alternative through assumes priority cleared. Neither reconstructs exact FIFO or proves profit.
Training partitions only; existing short source remains preliminary. No live orders, private API or account-specific fee verification.
Trace output is bounded; INCOMPLETE means aborted and must not be interpreted as a valid result.
